note: Restructured with the same split. production_fields (sender_type, sender_email, body_text, day_offset) map to app/models.py Message columns -- day_offset is the one computed field (converts to created_at at ingestion: ticket.created_at + day_offset), everything else there is a direct column value. generation_metadata (intent_type, tone, length_bucket, noise_level) has no real Interaction column counterpart at all -- intent_type shapes realistic thread structure during writing (benchmark_dataset_spec.md §3), tone/length_bucket/noise_level are benchmark style-slicing tags (§5) -- both exist only to produce and later analyze realistic synthetic text, never queried after generation. account_manager alias shared across the whole pilot: support@primecare-rcm.com (PrimeCare RCM Partners, our RCM vendor).

production_fields.body_text: Hi team, we just got a denial back from Aetna on claim CLM-88214 for patient PT-40217 (DOS 6/2). It looks like they're saying we're missing referral information on file. Can you take a look and let us know what's needed to get this resubmitted? Thanks, Denise
Hi Denise, thanks for flagging this. Can you confirm whether a referral was obtained from the PCP prior to the visit, and if so, do you have a copy we can attach to the appeal?
Yes we have it on file - attaching the referral form now. pt was referred by Dr. Alvarez on 5/28. let me know if you need anything else.
We've submitted the corrected claim with the referral attached. Aetna's typical turnaround is 10-14 business days - we'll follow up once we hear back.

Hi, I was reconciling ERAs and noticed Medicare paid claim CLM-77031 (PT-40988, 99397 wellness visit) at a lower rate than our contracted fee schedule. Can someone check into whether this was posted correctly or if we need to dispute with Medicare?
Thanks Denise - pulling the ERA and comparing against the current Medicare fee schedule for CPT 99397 now. Will update you shortly.
Confirmed there's a discrepancy - the posted amount is about $18 under the contracted rate. We're filing a reprocessing request with Medicare.
hey any update on the medicare thing? just want to make sure its moving
Still pending with Medicare - reprocessing requests are running about 3 weeks right now. Will let you know as soon as it moves.
ok thanks for staying on it, appreciate the update
Hi, we have a patient (PT-41102) scheduled for a lumbar MRI on 5/5 and BCBS is requiring prior authorization. Can you submit the request? Ordering physician is Dr. Nakamura.
Submitted the auth request to BCBS today with the clinical notes from Dr. Nakamura.
Update - BCBS initially pushed back asking for additional documentation on conservative treatment tried prior to imaging. We've submitted the PT records to address this.
Good news - BCBS approved the authorization for the lumbar MRI. Auth number is on file if you need it for scheduling.
Great, thank you for pushing this through so quickly!
Can you verify Aetna eligibility and copay for PT-41390 ahead of their 7/10 appointment?
On it - checking with Aetna now, will confirm the effective date and copay shortly.
Still waiting on Aetna's portal to reflect an updated effective date - following up with their provider line directly.

We got a denial on claim CLM-59902 for PT-39880 (DOS 3/14) - Medicare is saying it was submitted past the timely filing deadline. We definitely submitted this on time originally, back in March, so I think this might be an error on their end or something got lost. Can you help us appeal this?
Thanks Denise - can you send over any proof of the original submission date (clearinghouse confirmation, etc.) so we can include it in the appeal?
attaching the clearinghouse ack showing it went out 3/20, well within the window.
Perfect, that's exactly what we need. Filing the appeal with Medicare today along with the submission confirmation.
Following up with Medicare on the appeal status - no decision yet, they said allow up to 30 days.
Good news - Medicare overturned the denial and the claim has been reprocessed for payment.
Awesome, thanks so much for sticking with this one!
Hi, I noticed a UnitedHealthcare payment for claim CLM-90341 (knee injection, PT-52210) appears to have posted to a different patient's account. Can someone look into correcting this?
Thanks for catching that Priya - can you confirm which patient account it mistakenly posted to, if you can see it on your end?
looks like it went onto acct for a different pt with a similar last name, PT-52233. sending screenshot
Got it, thank you. We're correcting the posting now and will move the payment to the right account.
Just confirming - the payment has been reallocated to PT-52210's account. Let us know if the balance looks right on your end.
We have a patient balance (PT-51780, post-op follow-up) that's now over 90 days past due. Wanted to check in on next steps before we send it to collections.
Thanks - before we escalate, do you want us to attempt one more statement/call to the patient, or move straight to collections given the age of this balance?
let me check with the office and get back to you on that
Just following up - still waiting to hear which direction you'd like to go on this one before we proceed.

Hi, we had a case where the surgeon performed both the primary procedure and a hardware removal in the same visit for PT-52401, but it looks like only the primary procedure got billed. The hardware removal (with appropriate modifier) seems to be missing from the claim entirely. Can you add this in before we submit?
Thanks Priya - can you send over the operative note so we can confirm the CPT code and modifier for the hardware removal?
attaching op note now, should have everything you need
Reviewed the op note - confirming CPT 20680 with modifier 51 for the hardware removal alongside the primary procedure. Adding this to the charge now.
any update on this one?
Charge has been added and the claim is queued for submission - should go out in the next batch today.
Claim submitted with both procedures included. Will monitor for the payer response.
Perfect, thank you for catching and fixing this.
Getting a rejection on CLM-84410 (PT-50992) saying it's a duplicate. Can you confirm if the original was already paid?
Confirmed - the original claim was paid back on 4/25, this was just a duplicate resubmission being flagged correctly by the clearinghouse. No action needed.
got it, thanks for the quick check!

Hi, the prior authorization for PT-52560's shoulder surgery expired because the surgery date got pushed back. Surgery is now scheduled for 7/5 - can you get the auth renewed with UnitedHealthcare before then?
Thanks Tom - do you have the new surgery date confirmed in writing from the surgeon's office so we can attach it to the renewal request?
Yes, confirmation letter attached with the new date.
Submitted the renewal request to UnitedHealthcare today with the updated surgery date and original clinical documentation.
Still pending with UnitedHealthcare - following up given the surgery date is approaching.
Hi, Aetna denied claim CLM-73301 for PT-61120's lumbar epidural injection - they're citing lack of medical necessity documentation. Can you help get this appealed with the clinical notes?
Thanks Angela - can you send over the physician's clinical notes documenting the conservative treatments tried before the injection?
attaching dr's notes - pt tried PT and NSAIDs for 6 weeks before this
Great, that should cover the medical necessity requirement. Submitting the appeal to Aetna with this documentation today.
Appeal still under review with Aetna - no decision yet, will follow up again next week.
We got a denial on CLM-73588 for PT-61340's cervical epidural injection - Medicare says there's a missing modifier on the procedure code. Can you get this corrected and resubmitted?
Thanks Angela - can you confirm which side/level the injection was performed at so we apply the correct modifier?
it was right-sided, C6-C7 level per the op note
Corrected claim resubmitted with the appropriate modifier attached - will follow up once we hear back from Medicare.
Hi, the payment we posted for CLM-74010's facility fee doesn't match what's on the EOB from Workers' Comp. Can someone reconcile this?
Thanks - pulling both the ERA and EOB now to compare line by line.
Found the discrepancy - looks like a duplicate adjustment was applied when posting. Correcting the ledger now.
any update on the wc payment issue?
Correction has been made - the facility fee balance should now match the EOB. Let us know if it looks right on your end.
confirmed, looks correct now. thanks!

We have a patient (PT-60210) with a balance from a series of epidural injections back in January that's now significantly past due. We've sent several statements with no response. At this point I think we need to move this to collections - can you help facilitate that process?
Understood - before escalating, can you confirm how many statements/calls have gone out and over what time period?
3 statements since feb, 2 phone attempts, no response either way. attaching the statement log
Thanks for the documentation. We'll proceed with escalating this account to our collections partner per your practice's standard policy.
Account has been submitted to collections - they'll take it from here and report back on any recovery.
hey hows this account looking, any movement
No payment recovered yet from the patient - collections agency confirmed still working the account.
Understood, please go ahead and close this out on our end for now, we'll revisit if anything changes.
Will do - closing this ticket out. Let us know if you'd like us to reopen if the patient makes contact.
Can you confirm PT-61710's Workers' Comp claim is active before we schedule their procedure on 7/15?
Checking with the WC carrier now - will confirm claim status shortly.
Still waiting on a callback from the adjuster - following up again today.
Medicare is requiring a peer-to-peer review before they'll approve the spinal cord stimulator trial for PT-60890. Can you help coordinate that with the physician?
Scheduled the peer-to-peer call between Dr. Whitfield and Medicare's reviewing physician for next week.
Peer-to-peer review completed and Medicare has approved the authorization for the SCS trial.
Great news, thank you for setting that up!
Hi, I think the vaccine admin charge for PT-20044 (CLM-30110) was entered with the wrong number of units. Can you double check before this goes out?
Thanks Sarah, reviewing the charge entry now against the visit note - will confirm shortly.
BCBS sent a letter saying they overpaid claim CLM-29980 (well-child visit, PT-19980) and are requesting a refund. Can you confirm this is accurate before we process anything?
Thanks Sarah - can you forward the BCBS refund request letter so we can verify the amount against our records?
attached the letter, they say we owe back $42
Confirmed the overpayment amount matches our posting records. We'll process the refund back to BCBS.
Refund has been processed and sent to BCBS - this should close out the discrepancy.
We got a denial on CLM-29500 (PT-19750, sick visit) - looks like the diagnosis code doesn't support the procedure billed. Can you help identify the right code and resubmit?
Thanks Sarah - can you send the visit note so we can confirm the correct diagnosis code from the physician's documentation?
sending the note now, dr said it was likely coded too generally
Reviewed the note and identified a more specific diagnosis code that supports the billed procedure. Updating the claim now.
any update on this one?
Corrected claim has been resubmitted with the updated diagnosis code - will monitor for the payer response.
I noticed there's a credit balance sitting unapplied on PT-19510's account from an old overpayment. Can this be reallocated to their current balance?
Thanks Sarah - confirming which specific claim the credit originated from before we reallocate it.
Confirmed the credit is from CLM-28800's overpayment. We've reallocated it to the patient's current open balance.
perfect, thank you!
Hi, our eligibility check for PT-88120 shows their Medicaid coverage as terminated, but the patient is insisting they're still covered. Can you re-verify before their session on 7/12?
Thanks James - re-checking with Medicaid's portal directly now, will confirm shortly.
Still showing terminated on our end as of today - recommend having the patient confirm directly with Medicaid in case there's a recent update not yet reflected.
Got a denial on CLM-10230 (PT-87920, 60-min psychotherapy) - Medicare says it's a duplicate of a session billed the day before. Can you check into this?
Thanks James - can you confirm from the schedule whether two separate sessions actually occurred on consecutive days?
checked the schedule - looks like this one actually was entered twice by mistake, my bad
No worries - we'll void the duplicate entry and make sure only the correct session date remains billed.
Duplicate has been voided and the claim record is now corrected.
thanks for catching that and fixing it quickly
We have a newly credentialed therapist starting sessions next week, but I don't think their charge-entry profile is set up yet. Can we get this finalized before sessions start?
Thanks Linda - can you send over the provider's NPI and taxonomy code so we can finish setting up the profile?
checking with credentialing on this, will send info soon
Following up - still waiting on the NPI/taxonomy details to complete the charge-entry setup before sessions can be billed.
Cigna returned our prior auth request for PT-88310's intensive outpatient program as incomplete. Can you help figure out what's missing and resubmit?
Thanks James - Cigna's notice mentions missing clinical justification. Can you get an updated treatment summary from the clinician?
got the updated summary from the clinician, attaching now
Resubmitted the prior auth request to Cigna with the updated clinical justification included.
Still pending with Cigna - will follow up again if we don't hear back within their standard window.

Hi, we've noticed that several weeks of therapy session payments for PT-87500 have been posting with a contractual adjustment that doesn't seem to match the current Medicare fee schedule. This has been happening consistently since early May and it's adding up across multiple dates of service. Can someone take a look at the whole pattern rather than just one claim?
Thanks James - can you send a list of the specific dates of service affected so we can review each one against the fee schedule?
sending the list now - looks like every mon/wed session since 5/1 has the same issue
Reviewed the first few dates - confirmed the contractual adjustment percentage being applied is outdated. Escalating this to Medicare for a fee schedule review.
any update on the medicare fee schedule thing?
Still working through it with Medicare - they've acknowledged the discrepancy and are reviewing all affected dates.
Medicare confirmed the fee schedule used for adjustment was outdated and has agreed to reprocess all affected claims since 5/1.
great news - any idea on timeline for the reprocessing?
Medicare estimates 4-6 weeks for the full batch reprocessing to complete.
Checking in with Medicare again on the reprocessing batch - about halfway through the affected claims so far.
Update - most of the affected claims have now been reprocessed at the correct rate. A few dates are still pending, will continue monitoring.
appreciate you staying on top of this one, it's been a long one!
